hooks.name: scaffold-property-test
hooks.description: Scaffold a Hypothesis property test for a new MCP tool.

action.prompt: The user created a file under mcp/tools/. If tests/properties/test_<name>.py does not exist, create it with a Hypothesis skeleton: imports, one strategy placeholder, and one test function named test_<name>_invariant containing a TODO that names the invariant from design.md it must cover. Do not write assertions beyond the TODO.
